author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
Initial release over 1 year ago on Overcast Network, Secondary release over 1 year ago on Avalanche Network A classic-feeling map. It is around 2 years old however it was updated to fit Avicus. It's my second map I ever made (first if you don't count a really bad one I made 2 years ago). It has a straight lineup but turns abruptly. Spawns are a good distance to the wools and there is some challenge due to the lava and webs. Have fun!

NOTE: Void building is disabled

Spawnkit:
Leather Helmet
Leather Chestplate
Leather Boots

Stone Sword
Bow (Infinity I)
16 logs
8 gravel
16 steak
1 golden apple

Arrow

Images
Download
